en.headline: Tin Hau entrance stall sells for 280,000 dollars at fair auction
en.dek: Bidding for the 2027 Victoria Park Lunar New Year fair opened on Wednesday. The new top fast-food pitch went for 280,000 dollars.
body: Open bidding for Victoria Park's 2027 Lunar New Year fair began on Wednesday, and the fast-food stall nearest the Tin Hau entrance sold for 280,000 dollars.

The auction is being held at the Lai Chi Kok Government Offices over three days for the park's 400 stalls. Stall A, by the Hing Fat Street entrance at Tin Hau, went for 280,000 dollars against a reserve of 120,470 dollars and was reported as the new top fast-food pitch. Stall C, closest to the Causeway Bay entrance and last year's leading fast-food pitch, sold for 260,000 dollars after 15 bids, about 13 per cent above the 230,000 dollars paid at the 2026 fair.

The fair is scheduled for 31 January to 6 February next year at 14 sites, with 939 wet-goods stalls, 599 dry-goods stalls and 26 fast-food stalls. Victoria Park reserves run from 6,530 dollars to 120,470 dollars, broadly in line with last year. Wednesday morning covered fast-food and wet-goods pitches, with wet goods continuing in the afternoon. Dry-goods bidding is set for Thursday and Friday morning.

zh.headline: 維園年宵天后入口快餐檔以28萬元成交
zh.dek: 2027年維園年宵攤位周三起在荔枝角政府合署公開競投。近天后興發街入口的A檔以28萬元成交，底價為120,470元。
body: 維多利亞公園2027年農曆年宵市場周三開始公開競投，近天后入口的快餐檔以28萬元成交。
競投一連三日在荔枝角政府合署進行，維園共有400個攤位。近天后興發街入口的A檔底價120,470元，以28萬元成交，據報成為新的快餐檔王。最接近銅鑼灣出入口、去年快餐檔王的C檔，經15口叫價後以26萬元成交，較2026年年宵的23萬元高出約一成三。
年宵市場訂於明年1月31日至2月6日，一連七日在14個地點舉行，設939個濕貨攤位、599個乾貨攤位和26個快餐攤位。維園攤位底價由6,530元至120,470元，與去年相若。周三上午競投快餐及濕貨，下午續投濕貨；乾貨則排在周四及周五上午。
